newsitem.title: USA: Players International vice chair to retire.
newsitem.headline: Players International vice chair to retire.

text.p: Players International Inc said on Monday its vice chairman and co-founder, David Fishman, will retire.
The company also said it plans to add four new outside directors to its board including Merv Griffin and named John Groom the chief operating officer.
Co-founder Edward Fishman will continue as chairman of the board but will no longer have operating responsibilities, Players said.

David Fishman would stay involved in two development projects for which he has had responsibility - the riverboat casino and entertainment complex in Maryland Heights, Mo., and the expansion of a riverboat casino complex in Metropolis, Ill., the company said.

Groom's position as COO is new, the company said. Most recently Groom was executive vice president of operations at Players and, before that, worked at Bally Entertainment Corp and Ceasars, a unit of ITT Corp.
One of the new board members will be Merv Griffin whose Griffin Group Inc and affiliates hold 17 percent of Players, making it the company's largest shareholder.

The other three new board members are Earl Webb, head of LaSalle Partners' Investment Banking Group, Charles Masson, a corporate finance consultant, and Jay Green, executive vice president and chief financial officer of Culbro Corp.
Both Masson and Green are on the board of Griffin Gaming & Entertainment Inc, pending the completion of the merger of Griffin Gaming and Sun International Hotels Ltd, Players said.
